english: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0,1\}\to\mathbb{R}$ be a function such that $2f(x)+f\left(\dfrac{1}{1-x}\right)=6x$ for all $x\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0,1\}$. Then the value of $f(-1)$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $f:\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0,1\}\to\mathbb{R}$ एक फलन है, जिसके लिए सभी $x\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0,1\}$ के लिए $2f(x)+f\left(\dfrac{1}{1-x}\right)=6x$ है। तब $f(-1)$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: Let $T(x)=\dfrac{1}{1-x}$. Then $T(T(x))=\dfrac{1}{1-\frac{1}{1-x}}=\dfrac{x-1}{x}$ and $T(T(T(x)))=x$, so $T$ permutes each orbit $\left\{x,\dfrac{1}{1-x},\dfrac{x-1}{x}\right\}$ cyclically; all three points avoid $0$ and $1$ when $x\ne0,1$.
The given relation at $x=-1$: $2p+q=-6$. At $x=\dfrac12$: $2q+s=3$. At $x=2$: $2s+p=12$.
From the first, $q=-6-2p$; then $s=3-2q=3+12+4p=15+4p$; the third gives $30+8p+p=12$, so $9p=-18$ and $p=-2$.
originality_note: New: a functional relation linking x with its image under the order-3 map x -> 1/(1-x), solved on a single orbit {-1, 1/2, 2} by a 3x3 linear system (way 5). Closest known: f(x)+2f(1/x)=3x (order-2 substitution) and the olympiad f(x)+f(1-1/x)=1+x. Different because: the orbit has three points and the coefficients 2,1 make the system non-symmetric; only one orbit is needed.

concept_use.Miscellaneous concepts of Functions: The 3-cycle x -> 1/(1-x) -> (x-1)/x of a functional relation is used to set up and solve three linear equations for f(-1), f(1/2), f(2).

stem_review: Read as a student: domain excludes 0 and 1, where 1/(1-x) or the orbit is undefined; the relation determines f uniquely (system determinant 9). Answer -2 checked by solving the general system in sympy. Negative integer as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Noticing that x -> 1/(1-x) has order 3 so that -1, 1/2, 2 close up into three equations.
justification: Routine but multi-step: find the orbit, write three equations, solve. No real insight beyond the familiar substitution trick. Comparable to 2024-P2-Q8 (L2, functional equations, evaluate) and 2025-P1-Q1 (L2).
